records.title: Extent at diagnosis: a national recording gap

scope.population: New primary lung and trachea cancer cases

measure.definition: Cases without recorded extent-at-diagnosis information in this report

limitations: Missing registry information does not mean staging was not performed.
This national lung/trachea cohort does not estimate missingness in a selected county, other cancers or screening.
Do not subtract this percentage from a registry-coverage target with a different denominator.
records.comparability: National context only; excluded from county scores and intervention effects.
records.nextEvidenceNeeded: County and cancer-specific completeness, definitions and denominators before regional comparison.

records.title: An absent MDT code is not evidence of absent review

scope.population: New primary lung and trachea cancer cases

limitations: HILMO procedure recording centres on direct patient contacts and incompletely captures multidisciplinary review.
records.comparability: Do not rank MDT provision from absent procedure codes.
records.nextEvidenceNeeded: Validate recording practice against an agreed aggregate MDT denominator.

records.title: Goal 3: comparable outcomes and timely care
limitations: A policy goal is not a measured result or proof of an intervention effect.
records.comparability: Treatment-time performance needs cancer-specific targets, timestamps, eligible denominators and missingness.
records.nextEvidenceNeeded: Publish comparable county-level pathway coverage and time-to-treatment indicators.

future.title: Precision-diagnostics access

source.publisher: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health

future.proposal: Compare indicated molecular testing and sample-to-result time after suitable aggregate data becomes available.
future.boundary: A Goal 4.3 extension with a possible equity contribution. BioNeMo remains an unevaluated technical option; no molecular model or clinical benefit is claimed.
